concept: A restrained conceptual product walkthrough: each scene presents one billing action and its direct result with aligned administrative surfaces, plain labels, and minimal decoration.

palette.assetRule: Official Microsoft Fluent System Icons retain their source geometry; product marks retain supplied colors.

material: light Microsoft-style administrative surfaces with crisp borders, quiet shadows, and a neutral canvas

motionSignature.name: Action and result
rules: each scene reveals the action first and the resulting state second
motion follows visible connectors, ordered events, or progressive disclosure
avoid decorative symbols, rotation, physical-paper metaphors, and unexplained moving tokens

composition.grammar: centered conceptual product surfaces with aligned controls, explicit state changes, and generous negative space
rules: Keep both upper corners free of small labels, scene names, and metadata.
Use one strong main title without a subtitle directly beneath it.
Place essential policy fields, status, and captions inside the centered portrait-safe column when the frame must survive a 1080x1920 crop.
Use icon plus text or shape plus text for state; never rely on color alone.

signatureMotif: None. The previously used black-and-coral reconciliation cross was removed because it had no self-evident product meaning.

sceneTreatments.s01: one headline above three service symbols feeding a simple usage meter
sceneTreatments.s02: project-scoped Microsoft 365 admin chrome with a focused billing-policy drawer
sceneTreatments.s03: billing-policy surface with ordered usage events, a budget threshold, and a standard alert notification
sceneTreatments.s04: configuration-test surface with a request, connected policy, and illustrative variable-consumption rows
sceneTreatments.s05: equal-height Microsoft 365 and Azure reporting surfaces joined by a labeled reporting-delay handoff
sceneTreatments.s06: aligned permission cards, three operating steps, and one closing statement

primarySubjects.s01: eligible service interactions being counted by a usage meter
primarySubjects.s02: a billing-policy drawer inside Microsoft 365 admin chrome
primarySubjects.s03: ordered usage events continuing after a budget alert
primarySubjects.s04: one test request validated by a connected policy before variable consumption appears
primarySubjects.s05: two aligned reporting surfaces joined by a reporting-delay arrow
primarySubjects.s06: permissions leading through Connect, Govern, and Observe

iconSource.name: Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons
iconSource.usage: Freeze only required regular or filled plain SVG glyphs locally; never use emoji as product UI icons.

productionLayers.captions: Static high-contrast near-black blocks with white text; captions carry accessibility narration while scene headlines remain short and non-duplicative.
productionLayers.music: Quiet built-in technology bed, looped and ducked under narration after final selection approval.
productionLayers.voice: Pending approved source: supplied or Clipchamp recording, or Azure Speech when callable.
productionLayers.generatedMedia: Intentionally omitted because image and video generation are unavailable and synthetic product UI must remain deterministic. Chrome plus bespoke SVG/CSS supplies visual texture.
